name: LibreChat
description: Enhanced ChatGPT Clone: Features Agents, MCP, Skills, DeepSeek, Anthropic, AWS, OpenAI, Responses API, Azure, Groq, o1, GPT-5, Mistral, OpenRouter, Vertex AI, Gemini, Artifacts, AI model switching, message search, Code Interpreter, langchain, DALL-E-3, OpenAPI Actions, Functions, Secure Multi-User Auth, Presets, open-source for self-hosting. Active
one_liner: A self-hosted, ChatGPT-style chat app that can talk to any AI model (OpenAI, Anthropic, and more), so a company can give employees a private 'ChatGPT' without sending data to OpenAI.
buyer: An IT director at a mid-size company, or a law firm partner, who wants an internal AI chat tool but can't use public ChatGPT for data-privacy or compliance reasons.
business_use_cases: A law firm deploys it internally as a private AI assistant so client documents never leave their own servers, directly solving the 'need a private AI chat that won't leak client data' problem.
A managed service provider offers 'private ChatGPT setup and hosting' as a productized service to its small-business clients.
A company standardizes on it internally so employees stop pasting sensitive data into public ChatGPT or Claude web apps.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting plus compliance hardening (SSO, audit logs, model routing) as a subscription for regulated industries
Sell one-time setup and integration consulting for companies rolling out an internal AI chat tool

steal_this: Deploy it this weekend for a local law firm or clinic contact, wire it to a privacy-respecting model API, and pitch it as their 'private, compliant ChatGPT' for a flat setup fee plus monthly hosting.
